_comment: Permanent URL registry. fixes: bad URL → known correct replacement applied on every validation run. skip: URLs known to be dead/wrong with no reliable fix — validator records them without spending an HTTP request.

https://windsurf.com.reason: Windsurf rebranded as Devin Desktop after Cognition acquisition; devin.ai/desktop is the official product page

https://codeium.com/windsurf.reason: Windsurf rebranded as Devin Desktop after Cognition acquisition

https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai.reason: cloud.google.com/vertex-ai redirects to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; /docs is the correct Vertex AI entry point

https://www.jetbrains.com/ai/.reason: jetbrains.com/ai/ now redirects to JetBrains Air (a different product); /ai-assistant/ is the correct AI Assistant page

https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/.reason: OpenAI migrated docs — keep checking for a stable redirect target

https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/micr.reason: generator pointed to a OneNote Notebooks support page instead of the Microsoft 365 Copilot product page

Databricks ML product page now redirects to /product/artificial-intelligence
